verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's changelog announces AI-generated Post-Incident Reviews as generally available, started from the incident detail page or Slack. The PIR docs say reviews draw on the incident lifecycle, Slack data and the Scribe Agent's meeting transcripts to build chronological incident narratives, uncover systemic patterns and coordinate preventative follow-up actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exactly what the AI draft contains (e.g. contributing factors specifically) and of the human review/edit step, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
